subject: AEON usage health, first-mile economics & scaling sentiment
messages:
From: Morgan Lee <morgan@aeon.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@aeon.ai
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AEON token report + renewal touchpoint (Q1 usage)

Hi Olga,

Sharing a quick export of our Q1 token usage and a couple of notes from the product team — attached as CSV. We're coming up on the contract renewal window in July and want to make sure we understand our first-mile economics (we've seen a lot of short, high-frequency inference calls from new features).

Top-line context:
- Monthly token spend jumped ~42% MoM in March after the in-app assistant shipped.
- Average prompt length is short (~65 tokens) but we have many concurrent users which spikes latency-sensitive requests.

Can you help confirm:
1) Whether the current model mix & batching profile is still the recommended route for AEON's mix (short, low-latency calls)?
2) Any immediate steps that would materially reduce unit cost without significant regression risk?

Attaching AEON_Q1_token_report.csv. Would like to schedule a 30m touchpoint this week if possible.

Thanks,
Morgan
Morgan Lee
Head of Product Operations | AEON
Attachment: AEON_Q1_token_report.csv (CSV, 233KB)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan@aeon.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AEON token report + renewal touchpoint (Q1 usage)

Morgan,

Thanks for the CSV — helpful. Quick read: your burst profile and short token lengths make you a strong candidate for prefix-KV caching + lighter quantization for the small completion model. We can likely reduce per-token cost ~18-25% with minimal impact to quality.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30m call to align on traffic windows and SLA needs (I included Rachel for ops specifics and Ben for renewal/contract implications).
- We'll run a short A/B on the suggested batching/cache config for 72 hours against a held-out traffic slice.
- Deliverables: a short ROI summary (est. savings, perf delta) and a recommended commit tier for July renewal.

Proposed times: Tue 05/04 11:00-11:30 PT or Tue 05/04 15:00-15:30 PT. Let me know which works.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Exec, Renewals | Redwood Inference
Attachment: first-mile-econ-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: AEON — ops checklist before 72h A/B

Olga / Ben,

Looping in ops items before we run the experiment Morgan asked for:
- Please confirm the target subset (we should pick a single region + user cohort to avoid cross-region routing effects). Recommendation: US-West, new-button cohort (IDs in shared Drive doc).
- I will provision a cache-prefetch config and enable continuous batching windows during the known peak (17:00-20:00 UTC) for the 72h window.
- Instrumentation: token breakdown by prompt/completion, latency p50/p95, and a small QA eval on 100 prompts to spot quality regressions.

Note on expected impact: with AEON's token distribution, the cache + smaller quantized variant should reduce GPU cycles per request by ~20% while keeping p95 latency within the SLA. We'll capture actual numbers in the ROI sheet.

I'll prepare the runbook and the evaluation checklist and drop links in the calendar invite.

-rachel
Rachel Kim
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan@aeon.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AEON token report + renewal touchpoint (Q1 usage)

Morgan — thanks for the data and context. Great call with Olga and Rachel earlier. Quick summary and ask from the commercial side:

Summary:
- We validated a 72h A/B plan targeted at US-West, new-button cohort (per Rachel's note).
- Expected savings: 18-25% unit-cost reduction (conservative estimate 18%) if AEON adopts the caching + quantization profile at scale.
- Performance: p95 within SLA in staging runs; we'll confirm during production window.

Commercial ask / renewal implications:
- If the production A/B confirms the conservative savings estimate, I recommend AEON consider shifting 40% of expected monthly consumption into a dedicated commit for the next 12 months. That provides a meaningful blended price while preserving burst capacity on hosted.
- I can prepare two options for you: (A) 12m 40% commit + burst credits; (B) 24m 60% commit with steeper unit discounts. I'll include estimated monthly $ delta and the ROI recovery payback.

Next steps:
1) Run the 72h A/B (ops lead: Rachel) — starts tonight at 20:00 UTC.
2) Ben to share commercial options and a draft amendment by EOD Friday.
3) Olga to coordinate a 30m review call for preliminary results early next week.

Thanks — will follow up with the amendment draft and the ROI table once the A/B completes.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
